pairs.subject: mesh-finishing-for-engine-readiness
pairs.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:644 The finished low-poly counts as delivered once the script's DONE marker names a path that exists. Neither the TS runner nor pof_mesh_finish.py (which checks only os.path.exists after export_scene.gltf) reads the GLB back to count meshes and objects or to check bounds, so an empty or foreign-object export would still pass. A second deviation: the UV mode defaults to an explicit 'smart' projection instead of first detecting authored UVs.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:644 Delivery is claimed from the file existing, not from a content read-back. The script's export step ends with only an os.path.exists check, and the receipt has no checked/counts/issues fields.

src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:480 Projection is the explicit default, which the technique names as the failure: a caller who omits the mode overwrites authored UVs. The pack→smart fallback is reported (UV_MODE_FALLBACK, line 591), which is the conformant part.
src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:389 unwrapPlan refuses an unwrap with no decimation, or one above a 200k-face ceiling, and gives a named reason (unwrapSkippedReason). Bakes are gated on the unwrap.
src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:265 Shading has one owner: authored custom normals win, the angle pass is refused with shadingSkippedReason, and the applied shading is recorded.
src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:439 Metallic is named as absent with its reason (bakeSkipped), not faked with a constant. Bakes that ran and failed are reported separately (bakeFailed).

src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:112 Behaviour in headless mode is live-probed and recorded with the app version and date. The cull-operator limits and the custom-normal no-op are measured on Blender 4.2 the same way.

pairs.subject: mesh-finishing-for-engine-readiness
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/steps/shared/useGeneratedMeshAssets.ts:14 The shared step primitives only list and preview already-served .glb files, mesh-finish output among them, through a read-only route. They never reduce, unwrap, bake, bind or export a mesh. A case-insensitive search of src/components/layout-lab/steps/shared for unwrap/retopo/crease/bake returned zero hits.

pairs.subject: mesh-finishing-for-engine-readiness
